title: 少于 3 个方案且无当前豁免时不可出图
prompt: 单图或少于三条产品路径的原型计划，除非当前 run 明确确认豁免原因，否则不能写 image-2 prompt。

required_behaviors: image preflight 检查当前输出单元数量
少于 3 个方案需要当前 run 的明确豁免事件
dashboard 也显示少于 3 个方案且无豁免
forbidden_behaviors: 把一个方案换配色当三方案

contract_checks.contains: 少于 3 个方案且无豁免

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp" PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=one-scheme; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['PMW_HOME'])/'projects'/os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG']; (root/'runs').mkdir(parents=True)
proj={'slug':os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG'],'current_run_id':'run1','latest_run_id':'run1','latest_run_status':'已开始','current_task_digest':'digest','current_input_revision':'rev'}
(root/'project.json').write_text(json.dumps(proj, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
(root/'runs'/'run1.jsonl').write_text('', encoding='utf-8')
(root/'prototype-board.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'record_type':'item','run_id':'run1','scheme':'A','screen':'首屏','task_digest':'digest','input_revision':'rev'}, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
bin/pmw-image-preflight check --json
contains: 默认最少 3 个方案；少于 3 个必须有当前 run 的明确豁免原因
